app.title: D-Terminal
app.tagline: Windows users deserve the matrix too.

admin.elevatedHint: Running with administrator privileges — all spawned panes inherit the admin token.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Agent-aware Windows terminal — pre-alpha
welcome.openFirstPane: Press {shortcut} to open your first pane
welcome.maskHint: Sensitive field (GDPR) — revealing it is your responsibility. Re-masked when the pane refreshes.

pane.closeConfirm: Close this pane? Running process will be terminated.
pane.zoomHint: Zoom mode — press Ctrl+Shift+Z to restore

usage.heuristicNote: Token count is an estimate (~4 chars/token). Cost computed from model pricing; actual API bill may differ slightly.

brainstorm.toggle: Send the same question to multiple AIs in parallel (max {0} models, 1 round)
brainstorm.needTwo: At least 2 different AI providers must have API keys configured.
brainstorm.limitReached: At most {max} AIs — token limit to keep cost in check.

ai.title: AI Chat
ai.noProvider: No AI provider configured yet. Add an API key in settings.
ai.placeholder: Ask a question or give a task…

errors.ollamaNotRunning: Cannot reach Ollama local server (default: localhost:11434)

redact.preview: Preview text being sent to AI

suggest.title: AI Command Generator
suggest.promptLabel: What do you want to do?
suggest.promptPh: e.g. show me the last 10 commits, graph view only
suggest.insertHint: Paste into active terminal, do not press Enter
suggest.executeHint: Paste + send Enter into active terminal
suggest.hint: Generates a command for the active pane type (PowerShell/CMD/WSL). Always review before executing.

aiCost.title: AI Token & Cost Tracking
aiCost.note: Token counts are estimated (~4 chars/token). Cost computed from model pricing; actual API bill may differ slightly.
aiCost.limitHint: When exceeded, a warning shows on the Month card. Empty = no limit.
aiCost.clearConfirm: Delete all AI usage records? This cannot be undone.

general.adminRunningAsAdmin: ✓ Running with administrator privileges — winget upgrade, system services, HKLM registry writes all permitted.
general.adminRunningAsUser: Running with standard user privileges. Commands requiring admin (e.g. `winget upgrade --all`) may fail for some packages.
general.adminRestartConfirm: D-Terminal will close and relaunch with UAC elevation. All running pane processes will be terminated. Continue?
general.adminSudoHint: Instead of running the entire app as admin for one command, use a sudo-like tool: Win 11 23H2+ users can enable built-in `sudo` from Settings → System → For developers; Win 10 users can install gsudo (gerardog/gsudo).
general.gsudoCopied: Copied to clipboard: winget install gerardog.gsudo
general.configFileHint: Export your full settings to / import from a TOML file. Useful for dotfile sync. Hot-reload arrives in v1.0.5 — for now, import manually.
general.configImportConfirm: Current settings will be replaced by the values in the TOML file. Continue?
general.configImportOk: Imported {count} setting(s) — restart may be required
general.aiPrefixHash: Open AI command generator on # at empty prompt (Warp parity)
general.aiPrefixHashHint: When enabled: typing # at the start of an empty prompt opens the AI suggester instead of writing # to the terminal. Disable to use # normally.

appearance.themeHint: Color palette, font, and background effects
appearance.rendererHint: GPU acceleration — fall back to Canvas/DOM on compat issues
appearance.screenReaderHint: Opens an aria-live region for screen readers (NVDA/Narrator); has a performance cost
appearance.prefixModeHint: Press the combo to enter modal mode for 1s, then trigger an action with V/H/Z/X/N/P/T/W/S/O
appearance.vibrancyHint: Acrylic applies a GPU-heavy blur, may reduce FPS on window resize

providers.title: AI Provider Configuration
providers.keyStored: Key stored in local encrypted vault (Windows DPAPI)
providers.cloudHint: Uses your API key — billed to your account.
providers.localHint: User installs on their own machine. D-Terminal auto-connects when the service is running. Data stays local, zero cost.

localDesc.ollama: Most popular local AI runtime. Pull models (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, ...) with 'ollama pull'.
localDesc.lmstudio: GUI-first local AI app. Browse + download + run models in one place.
localDesc.jan: Open-source local AI app. Ollama-like but with a full friendly GUI.
localDesc.llamacpp: Low-level runtime — the foundation of Ollama / LM Studio / Jan. CLI-launched, for advanced users.
localDesc.foundry: Microsoft's Windows-native AI runtime. NPU / DirectML acceleration support.

providers.customHint: For your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, Together AI, DeepInfra, Groq, enterprise Azure OpenAI, your own proxy).
providers.customEndpointHint: OpenAI Chat Completions API compatible base URL. Do NOT include /chat/completions — D-Terminal appends it automatically.
providers.customKeyHint: Stored here if your endpoint needs it. Local proxies may not require a key.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.conflict: This shortcut is already used for "{action}"
shortcuts.captureHint: Press the desired key combination (Esc to cancel)

session.name: Session name
session.workspaceMode: Save as workspace (all tabs + profiles + group tags)

newPane.title: New Pane
newPane.selectType: Pick a profile or pane type

profiles.title: Shell Profiles
profiles.hint: Built-in profiles (PowerShell/CMD/WSL) cannot be deleted. Add your own: pwsh 7, SSH host, Docker exec, Python REPL, …

field.name: Name
field.shellHint: Executable to run. Use plain name if on PATH, or full path.
field.argsHint: Whitespace separated; quote with "x y" or 'x y' for args containing spaces.

statusBar.broadcastHint: Mirror keyboard input to all terminal panes in active tab (Ctrl+Shift+B)

actions.zoomIn: Increase font size in active pane
actions.zoomOut: Decrease font size in active pane
actions.zoomReset: Reset font size in active pane

suggest.hint: Suggestion from history — accept with Tab or →

block.empty: No commands executed yet (waiting for OSC 133 markers)
block.sentToClipboardForAi: AI prompt copied to clipboard; paste into AI Chat pane
block.clearConfirm: Delete all recorded blocks in this pane?

snippet.exportHint: Download all snippets as JSON (for sharing)
snippet.importHint: Import snippets from a JSON file (Warp Drive lite)

logStream.empty: No stream — pick a file and start
